channel.title: Proxmox on ProHomeLab – everything about homelab and self-hosting
channel.description: Recent content in Proxmox on ProHomeLab – everything about homelab and self-hosting

item.title: Proxmox Backup Server 4.2.0: Installation, Configuration, and Proxmox VE Backup
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A complete guide to installing and configuring Proxmox Backup Server 4.2.0 for building a reliable backup system for Proxmox VE virtual machines and containers.

item.title: How to Merge local-lvm and local into a Single Storage in Proxmox
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A step-by-step guide to merging the local-lvm and local storages in Proxmox into a single logical storage. Covers the commands and settings that help you use space more efficiently and simplify management of virtual machines and containers.

item.title: Storage for HA in a Proxmox Cluster
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: An overview of the main types of storage in Proxmox with support for High Availability (HA). Covers local-lvm, Ceph, NFS, and other solutions, their advantages and limitations, plus recommendations for choosing a reliable and scalable cluster.

item.title: Proxmox Cluster: Setup, QDevice, and Mixed Hardware in Nodes
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A detailed guide to building and configuring a cluster in Proxmox. Covers steps for joining multiple nodes, setting up highly available virtual machines and containers, plus basic recommendations for cluster management and monitoring.

item.title: Why I Don't Need Ceph Storage in Proxmox for My Home Server
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A breakdown of why Ceph can be overkill for home use. Covers the complexity of setup and maintenance, resource costs, and recommendations for simpler and more efficient alternatives for a home server and Proxmox.

item.title: How to Set Up a Firewall in Proxmox VE: Step-by-Step Guide
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A detailed guide to configuring Proxmox’s built-in firewall to protect virtual machines and containers. Covers creating rules, configuring network zones, traffic management, and recommendations for securing your cluster.

item.title: Proxmox SDN: A Complete Guide to Setup and Usage
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A detailed guide to configuring SDN in Proxmox for centralized management of virtual networks. Covers creating virtual network segments, configuring VXLAN, integrating with the firewall, and recommendations for managing network resources.

item.title: Upgrading from Proxmox VE 8 to Proxmox VE 9: A Step-by-Step Guide
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A step-by-step guide to safely migrating from Proxmox 8 to version 9. Covers server preparation, backups, package upgrades, and compatibility checks for virtual machines and containers to minimize downtime.

item.title: Installing and Configuring a Cloud-Init Image in Proxmox
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A detailed guide to setting up CloudInit for automatic server configuration. Covers key files, parameters, and examples for quickly deploying Linux systems with minimal effort.

item.title: Setting Up Templates and Linked Clones in Proxmox VE
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A step-by-step guide to creating and configuring templates in Proxmox for quickly deploying virtual machines and containers. Covers creating templates, saving configurations, and recommendations for managing and updating images.

item.title: Setting Up SSL Certificates in Proxmox with the Built-in ACME
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A detailed guide to setting up SSL in Proxmox for secure access to the web interface and API. Covers certificate generation and installation, HTTPS setup, and recommendations for maintaining cluster security.
